meta.title: Our story
meta.description: Meet Adrian and Alondra, the parents behind Tiny Humans: newborn and baby photos at home, anywhere from Miami to Orlando.

hero.title: Hi, we're Adrian & Alondra
hero.intro: We're the husband-and-wife team behind Tiny Humans, and parents ourselves. We bring the studio to your home, so your little one can stay warm, fed and comfy while we capture these first weeks.

story.title: How Tiny Humans started
paragraphs: It started with our own newborn. We wanted those sleepy, curled-up first photos, but we didn't want to pack up a brand-new baby and drive across town to a studio. We looked for a photographer who would come to our home, and we couldn't find one.
Adrian had been behind the camera for about two years, photographing all kinds of things. Once our baby arrived, newborns and little ones became the moments we most wanted to capture.

meet.title: Meet Adrian & Alondra
paragraphs: Tiny Humans started with our own newborn. We wanted photos at home, and we couldn't find anyone who would come to us. So we became that photographer.
Home is where babies, and parents, are most comfortable: no car seat, no packing the whole nursery, and feeding whenever baby wants.
Adrian photographs and edits every session. Alondra designs the set-ups, styling and little details. We're parents too, and we know how fast these first weeks go.

items.q: Is it safe for a newborn?
items.a: Yes, safety always comes first. We keep the room warm, wash and sanitize our hands, and never use unsupported poses: any tricky pose is a safe composite of two photos. A parent stays within arm's reach, and we don't wear fragrance.

items.q: How soon after birth should we book?
items.a: Any time that suits you. The first couple of weeks are lovely for sleepy, curled-up newborn photos, and we photograph little ones up to 2 years old. Expecting? Book with your due date and we'll adjust the day once baby arrives.

items.q: What if baby comes early or late, or is fussy or hungry?
items.a: Every session goes at baby's pace, with feeding and cuddle breaks built in. You can move or cancel your session online up to {notice} before, or just text us. And if baby can't settle, we'll come back once, free, within 14 days.
items.aDeposit: Every session goes at baby's pace, with feeding and cuddle breaks built in. You can move or cancel your session online up to {notice} before (cancel and we refund your deposit), or just text us. And if baby can't settle, we'll come back once, free, within 14 days.

items.q: How much space do we need?
items.a: Just a little space, ideally near a window. We bring the lights, backdrops, props and outfits for baby.
We bring outfits and wraps for baby. For family photos, soft solid colors look beautiful: cream, beige, sage or light blue. Skip big logos and busy patterns.

items.q: Can siblings and pets be in the photos?
items.a: Siblings and parents join with Our Family Story. Little Moments and Our Little Story are baby only. Want a pet in the photos? Tell us in your booking notes and we'll plan for it.

items.q: Which areas do you cover? Is there a travel fee?
items.a: We're based in Miami Beach and travel anywhere from Miami to Orlando. Homes farther away may have a travel fee, and we'll always confirm it with you before your session.
items.aFee: We're based in Miami Beach and come to homes up to {max} miles away. The first {free} miles are free; after that it's {perMile} a mile, and you'll see the exact travel fee as soon as you type your ZIP code.

items.q: When do we get the photos, and how do we pay?
items.a: Within 24 hours of your session, you'll get a private gallery to choose your favorites (as many as your bundle includes). We edit your picks and deliver them within 72 hours. Nothing is due today: you pay after your session by card, with a secure link we email you.
items.aDeposit: Within 24 hours of your session, you'll get a private gallery to choose your favorites (as many as your bundle includes). We edit your picks and deliver them within 72 hours. When you book, a {deposit} deposit holds your date and counts toward your total. The rest is paid after your session, by card, with a secure link we email you.

prepGuide.title: Your Home Session Prep Guide
items: Warm the room you'd like photos in, so baby stays sleepy and comfy.
Pick the room with your biggest window. Just a little space is all we need.
Feed baby just before we arrive. A full tummy means a sleepy baby, and we'll pause for more feeds anytime.
Parents: wear soft, solid colors (no logos or busy patterns) if you'll be in the photos.
Skip perfume and scented lotion on the day.
Want a pet in the photos? Reply to this email and we'll plan for it.
Nothing to pay today: you pay after your session by card, with a secure link we email you.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Tiny Humans is a newborn and baby photography studio in Miami, Florida that comes to you. This policy explains what information we collect when you visit our website or book a session, how we use it, and the choices you have. We keep it simple: we only collect what we need to take care of your family's session.

sections.heading: Information we collect
body: When you book a session, you give us:

list: The parent or guardian's name, email address and phone number
Your baby's name (optional) and age
The package, date and time you choose
The home address where we'll set up for your session
Any notes or special requests you share
The portfolio photo you picked as inspiration, if any

body: We also note how you found us: the ad, link or website that brought you to our site (for example the campaign name in an ad link) and the first page you visited.
During your session we take photographs of your baby and, depending on your package, your family.

Like most websites, our hosting provider automatically records basic technical information when you visit, such as your browser type, the pages you view and your IP address. We also use advertising measurement tools from Meta (see "Advertising and measurement" below).

sections.heading: How we use your information

list: To schedule, prepare for and travel to your session at your home
To contact you about your booking, including reminders and any changes
To edit and deliver your photos through your online gallery
To keep business records we're required to keep
To keep our website working and secure, including limiting repeated requests from the same connection
To understand which ads and links bring families to us, and to measure and improve our ads on Facebook and Instagram

body: We never sell or rent your information.

sections.heading: Photos of your family
body: Your photos belong in your family's memories first. We will only show photos from your session in our portfolio, on this website or on social media (such as Instagram) if you give us permission. You can change your mind at any time, and we'll stop using them for anything new.

sections.heading: Advertising and measurement (Meta)
body: We advertise on Facebook and Instagram. To measure how our ads work, we use the Meta Pixel on our website and the Meta Conversions API from our server, both provided by Meta Platforms, Inc.

list: When you visit our website, the Meta Pixel may collect the pages you view, actions such as choosing a bundle or starting and completing a booking, and technical information such as your IP address and browser. It uses cookies (see below).

When you complete a booking, we send Meta a booking event with the bundle and price, together with your email address, phone number, name, city, state and ZIP code in hashed (scrambled) form, plus your IP address and browser details, so Meta can match the booking to an ad and show our ads to people more likely to be interested.
We never send your baby's name, age, notes or photos to Meta or any other advertising service.

body: Meta uses this information as described in its Privacy Policy (facebook.com/privacy/policy). You can control the ads you see in your Facebook and Instagram ad settings (facebook.com/adpreferences), and you can block or delete cookies in your browser settings.

sections.heading: Who we share information with
body: We share information only with trusted services that help us run Tiny Humans, and only what they need to do their job:

list: Website hosting and storage (Vercel)
Our booking database (Neon)
Our calendar (Microsoft 365 / Outlook)
Our email delivery service (Resend)

Our payment processor (Stripe), which takes your card payment on its own secure page. We share your email address, bundle, amount due and booking reference with Stripe; we never see or store your card number
A security service that limits repeated requests to our website (Upstash), which briefly processes IP addresses
Meta Platforms, for advertising measurement as described above
The online gallery service we use to deliver your photos

body: We may also share information if the law requires it, or to protect the safety of our clients, our team or others.

sections.heading: Cookies and browser storage
body: Our website uses these cookies:

list: Meta advertising cookies (_fbp and _fbc), set by the Meta Pixel to measure our ads, kept for up to 90 days
Our own cookies (th_src and th_fbc) that remember how you found our website, kept for 90 days
A sign-in cookie, used only for the private owner area of the site

body: Our website may also store small settings in your browser so pages work smoothly. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings; the website and booking will still work.

sections.heading: Children's privacy
body: Our website is meant for parents and guardians aged 18 or older. We collect information about babies and children only from their parent or guardian, and only to provide the photography session they've booked. We never share information about your baby or child with advertising or analytics services.

sections.heading: How long we keep information
body: We keep booking information for as long as we need it to provide your session and to meet our legal and accounting obligations. We keep your session photos on file for a limited time after delivery, so we can help if you lose access to your gallery. You can ask us to delete your photos or information sooner at any time.

sections.heading: Keeping your information safe
body: We use reasonable safeguards to protect your information, including secure connections on our website. No method of storing or sending information online is completely secure, but we work hard to protect yours.

sections.heading: Your choices
body: You can ask us to show you the information we have about you, correct it, or delete it. You can also ask us to stop sending you messages that aren't about an upcoming session. Just contact us and we'll take care of it.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: If we update this policy, we'll post the new version here and change the date at the top.

sections.heading: Contact us
body: Questions? Email us at hello@tinyhumans.photography, or message us on Instagram at @tinyhumans.photography.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms explain how booking and sessions work with Tiny Humans, a newborn and baby photography studio in Miami, Florida. By using our website or booking a session, you agree to them. If anything is unclear, please ask before you book.

sections.heading: Booking a session
body: You can book a session through our website. You'll receive a confirmation with your booking details. Nothing is paid at booking: payment for your bundle is due once your photoshoot is completed.
The person booking must be the baby's parent or legal guardian and at least 18 years old.

sections.heading: Packages and prices
body: Packages and prices are listed on our website. Once your booking is confirmed, your price won't change, even if our prices change later. Each package includes the session length, setups and number of edited digital photos described at the time you book.

sections.heading: Baby-led sessions
body: Our sessions are baby-led. Time is allowed for feeding, changing and comforting your little one whenever needed. Your baby's safety and comfort always come first: we never force a pose, and a parent or guardian must stay present for the whole session.

sections.heading: Rescheduling and cancellations
body: Babies keep their own schedules, and we understand. If your baby or anyone in your family is unwell, please let us know and we'll find a new date.
You're free to reschedule or cancel online, using the links in your confirmation email, up to {notice} before your session. Inside {notice}, just text us at {phone} and we'll help.
If you need to cancel or reschedule, please tell us as early as possible, so we can offer the time to another family. If you miss a session without telling us, we may ask for a deposit to rebook.
If we ever need to cancel because of illness or an emergency, we'll find a new date with you at no cost.

sections.heading: We bring the studio to you
body: Every session takes place at your home, so your little one can stay comfortable. We bring the lights, backdrops and props. Please provide a warm, safe space with room for our setup, ideally near a window, and let us know in advance about pets, parking or anything else we should be aware of.

sections.heading: Your photos
body: We carefully choose and edit your photos and deliver them through a private online gallery. The number of edited photos depends on your package. Editing style is part of our artistic work, and we don't provide unedited or raw files.

sections.heading: Copyright and how you can use your photos
body: Tiny Humans keeps the copyright to the photos. You receive a personal license to use them, which means you can:

list: Print them for yourself and your family
Share them with friends and family, including on your personal social media (a tag is always appreciated)

body: Please don't sell the photos, use them for commercial purposes, or add filters or edits and present them as our work without asking us first.

sections.heading: Showing your photos
body: We only show photos from your session in our portfolio, website or social media with your permission. See our Privacy Policy for details.

sections.heading: Our responsibility
body: We take great care of every session and every file. In the unlikely event that we can't deliver your photos because of something within our control, such as equipment failure, our responsibility is limited to refunding what you paid for that session. We aren't responsible for indirect losses.

sections.heading: Using our website
body: The photos, drawings and text on this website belong to Tiny Humans. Please don't copy or reuse them without permission.

sections.heading: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Florida.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
body: We may update these terms from time to time. The version on our website when you book is the one that applies to your session.

sections.heading: Contact us
body: Questions? Email us at hello@tinyhumans.photography, or message us on Instagram at @tinyhumans.photography.
